comment: Short forms for the widgets' tightest cells (item 36b): a 3- or 4-letter shortening of every place a favourite can carry — every tz city and every gazetteer name — keyed by the place's compact display name, lowercased. Shortened place names people write casually (LON, TOK, PAR, NYC, SÃO, KATH, PORT), not airport codes; a famous initialism may be two letters (LA, SF, HK, KL, DC). Generated in one batch on 2026-11-04 (Olivier's call: we own every name, so define them all), hand-correctable here. A name not listed falls back to its first three letters; a code label (ET) is its own short form. Read by both cores from this one file.
